column1: Existence of nonplanar graphs with a nice drawing whose Székely crossing-optimality set-system inequality can be proved for every simultaneous A_e assignment by theoretical tools, rather than exhaustive search (OWR-822-007 / 30000215).
column4: Existing positive instances, e.g. K3,3 and K5, follow from Székely, An Optimality Criterion for the Crossing Number, AMC1(2008),32-37, Theorem1, jointly with Pelsmajer–Schaefer–Štefankovič, Removing Even Crossings, JCTB97(2007),489-500, DOI https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jctb.2006.08.001 (strong Hanani–Tutte and Remark1 recording prior iocr=1 values with credit to Székely). Primary criterion: https://amc-journal.eu/index.php/amc/article/download/43/30 ; PSS body: https://www.cs.rochester.edu/~stefanko/Publications/JCTB%20-%20removing.pdf . Original: https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/45990?nt=1 , printed983. Reviewed PR: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/1346 . This row covers the bare original existence question only; these dependency DOIs are not authenticated publication of PR1346 full K3n/K4n all-n certificate. The p35 criterion proof D/D-prime optimality label is clarified by direct parity comparison; theorem unchanged, no author erratum authenticated.
